description: This Java source file defines a Fragment class named LogFragment, which contains a LogView for displaying log data within an Android application. It manages the setup of views, including a ScrollView and a custom LogView, and handles text change events to keep the log scrolled to the bottom.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays log messages using a custom LogView inside a ScrollView. It provides methods for inflating its views and ensures the log stays scrolled to the bottom when new text is added.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, sets padding, typeface, gravity, and text appearance, and returns the root ScrollView containing the LogView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout by calling inflateViews(), sets a TextWatcher to auto-scroll the ScrollView when log text changes, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
